task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for at least three tangent lines or vertical/diagonal segments illustrating the step-by-step approach toward the root in the Graphics View.

task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a text box in the Graphics View showing a value near 2.09 or 2.10.
